meta_og_title: Day Rehabilitation Center for Children with Disabilities
meta_og_description: We provide safe and caring environments where young children can heal and grow.
hero_slide_1_text: The Center operates in accordance with Government Decision no. 824 of 04.07.2008 "on the approval of the Minimum Quality Standards for social services provided in day centers for children with disabilities" and Regulation on the organization and functioning of the Day Rehabilitation Center for Children with Disabilities, Criuleni, dated January 02, 2025.
hero_slide_2_text: The Center was established by the decision of the Public Association "Woman and Child - Protection and Support" in partnership with the local Public Administrative Authorities based on the decision of the Criuleni Local Council no. 11/11 of 16.08.2000. Based on the Government Decision no. 181 of 17.02.2006, starting with 01.01.2006, the Center became subordinate to the Ministry of Social Protection, Family and Child.

about_section_title: Centrul de Reabilitare de Zi pentru Copii cu Dizabilități „Speranța” din orașul Criuleni
about_text_1: The Center is a state social assistance institution that provides day services to children with disabilities. Depending on the category of beneficiaries, we offer a supportive environment, assistance in recovery of development, support and mediation in relations with the family and the community.
about_text_2: Facilitating the successful integration of children with disabilities into society, by ensuring access to day rehabilitation services, as close as possible to their place of residence and family.
about_text_3: Children with disabilities aged 4 to 18, with sensory, physical/locomotor, mental/intellectual, psychological and behavioral limitations, who need special care and support, through the provision of specialized services and the support of their legal representatives.
